content.title: Pharma M&A deal value up 31% YoY in 2025YTD amid return of mega-deals
content.summary: Large M&A transactions and bidding wars for Metsera and Avadel announced in H2 2025 reflect a need for large pharma companies to replenish pipelines through M&A ahead of looming patent cliffs.

content.title: SNY Stock Down on Double Trouble With Multiple Sclerosis Drug

content.title: Sanofi MS drug hits two setbacks
content.summary: Tolebrutinib, which Sanofi acquired in a $3.7 billion buyout, failed a Phase 3 study in “primary progressive” multiple sclerosis and is facing a delayed U.S. approval decision in another form of the disease.
